title: Live MODFLOW6 Outer-Iteration Host

canonical_at_reconcile.head: f2d472cb0e4d935ef39f002d6f21c8d90acf4dd8
canonical_at_reconcile.assessment: Canonical advanced in unrelated PUB-P2E10 work after F-GC36; F-GC37 is based on the immutable qualified F-GC36 head and will recheck relevant dependency deltas before qualification.

external_lifecycle_finding.finding: MODFLOW6 XMI exposes prepare_time_step, prepare_solve, repeated solve, finalize_solve and finalize_time_step, but no qualified timestep checkpoint/rollback/restore API.
external_lifecycle_finding.decision: Do not implement live MODFLOW as groundwater_preparable_exchange_service_t. Use one in-place prepared solve and update F-GC34 terms between solve iterations.

next_permitted_action: Implement the additive live MODFLOW outer-iteration host and qualify repeated real F-GC34 publication within one prepared MODFLOW6 solve.
